text:
sophia: FYI our python sampleapp hit a pagination/backpressure issue during onboarding load test. page cursor loop + aggressive prefetch caused bursts to the /v1/chat endpoint.
dan: Any rate headers or logs?
sophia: snippet: ```HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 25
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 8
``` Also saw a lot of `401` then immediate token-refresh and retry flood.
prio: Token refresh + 0 jitter retries are classic. Which sdk and sample config?
sophia: py-sdk 1.2.0-beta, sample config: `max_workers=40`, `prefetch=3`, `retry_policy={'retries':2,'delay_ms':500}`
kevin: 40 workers + prefetch 3 = concurrent inflight ~120. That will spike quota. We should change sample defaults to conservative and teach ramping.
dan: Proposal: default `max_workers=10`, `prefetch=1`, and introduce an onboard_ramp env var that starts at 3 and scales to max over 20s. Also add leaky-bucket client limiter with token refill tied to `x-rate-limit-limit`.
sophia: Nice. For retries let's do exponential backoff with decorrelated jitter. Example helper: `sleep = base * (2 ** attempt) * (0.5 + random())`.
prio: Agree. Also add handling: if we see 401 then back off longer before token refresh to avoid stampeding the auth service. Maybe add a shared auth-refresh lock in the SDK so only one worker refreshes at a time per client.
kevin: Good call. We should also emit telemetry: attach `sdk_concurrency` and `prefetch` to events and log rate headers per failed request so we can tune defaults.
ratebot: Alert: onboarding-python-prod experienced quota trip at 2026-03-21T09:14:10Z 300s. Auto-mitigation: per-customer rate cap applied.
dan: Who wants to open the sampleapp PR with defaults + ramp + telemetry?
sophia: I'll open it and include an integration test that simulates a mocked /v1/chat returning 429 after N calls so we assert the limiter prevents further flurry. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-onboard-samples/pull/78
prio: I'll add the auth-refresh lock and jitter helper to the py-sdk and update quickstart docs.
kevin: Can we add a short guidance note in the onboarding README about "ramping vs blasting" and include recommended envs for heavy customers?
sophia: Yes, will add a small section with examples and a note about X-Client-Id header for per-tenant accounting.
dan: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Leaving the trace IDs in #eng-sre in case of followup.
